answer: According to the EDPB Statement 3/2024, data protection authorities (DPAs) must be designated as market surveillance authorities for high-risk AI systems listed in point 1 of Annex III of the AI Act, particularly when those systems are used for law enforcement purposes, border management, and justice and democracy. The EDPB recommends that DPAs should also be appointed as market surveillance authorities for the remaining high-risk AI systems listed in Annex III, especially in sectors likely to impact natural persons' rights and freedoms regarding the processing of personal data. Furthermore, the EDPB suggests that DPAs acting as market surveillance authorities should serve as the single points of contact for the public and counterparts at Member State and Union levels.
